none: PAS NLM-93DF91: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Caesarum Nostrorum issue of 321-324, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Youthful long necked bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: [?IVL] CONSS SS[--]CAES, appearance of double S's may be misleading. Reverse description: Wreath enclosing vow: VOT / X. Reverse inscription: [CAESARVM NOSTRORVM]. In exergue: CON. Diameter: 19.7mm, Weight: 2.09gms, die axis: 6
